exposure: Women without specific exclusion criteria (gestational age below 34 weeks, hypertension, hypo- or hyperthyroidism without treatment, any cardiac disease, infections with fever or sepsis, history of coagulopathy, delivery by C-section)
cohort: 186 women giving birth vaginally at Women's Hospital of the University of Campinas, Brazil, between February 1, 2015 and March 31, 2016
finding: This study established reference ranges for Shock Index and heart rate values in the first two hours after vaginal delivery, demonstrating small variations throughout this period.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at birth was 39.2 ± 1.8 weeks
